shots.action: Inside the concrete road tunnel, the driver in the red jacket strides in from the left edge and crosses the frame to the right in front of the black sports car, the red of the jacket flaring under each overhead sodium strip light in turn, boots scuffing the concrete. Behind the walking figure, the car's carbon fibre body stays parked and dark until its tail lamps blink awake, then its headlights swell from dim amber to a hard white cone that pushes the tunnel's far darkness back.
shots.what_changes: The red-jacketed figure crosses the frame left to right past the parked car, and the car's headlights come up from darkness to full beam.

sync_sound: the engine note rising as the car advances

shots.action: The shot cuts to the car head-on from low across the road surface. The last edge of the red jacket slips out of frame on the right as the black sports car pulls forward out of the dark, its headlights carving two long cones through the tunnel haze, the carbon fibre body sliding from near-black into the sodium glare, tyres rolling a slow quarter-turn as the nose advances toward the lens and the darkness closes behind it.
shots.what_changes: The black sports car emerges from the darkness and rolls forward into the light toward the camera.
